title: Smart Stock
desc: Replaces spreadsheet inventory tracking for small restaurants with live stock levels, low-stock and expiry alerts, and waste trends behind role-based access for owners, managers, and staff, plus a chat assistant that answers inventory questions in plain language. Demand forecasts come from a RandomForest service the frontend consumes defensively, so the UI degrades to cached numbers instead of breaking when the model is down. Smart Sourcing compares supplier pricing per ingredient to cut procurement cost.
tech: TypeScript, Next.js, React Server Components, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Vitest

title: JobMatch
desc:
Parses a résumé into a typed schema with the OpenAI API,
then matches it against live listings with KV-backed rate limiting.
Cuts the apply flow from ~30 minutes to under a minute.
tech: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, OpenAI API, Zod

title: Fragments Microservices
desc:
Cloud-native CRUD microservice for text, JSON, and images,
with content-type conversion and Cognito auth at the edge.
Metadata in DynamoDB, binaries in S3.
tech: Node.js, Express, AWS (Cognito, DynamoDB, S3), Docker

title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
desc:
Trains a simulated self-driving car
using CNNs and reinforcement learning.

title: AI Emotion Detector
desc:
Lightweight CNN facial-emotion recognition
trained on FER2013, with a real-time labeled feed
and a growing sample corpus for training a
triplet-loss classifier against the cascade baseline.

title: Gaming Laptop Recommender
desc: Scrapes live specs for 1,000+ gaming laptops into NoSQL through a Puppeteer pipeline, holding roughly 90% extraction success across Lenovo and Canada Computers with per-retailer selector configs. A Next.js chat front end recommends laptops by budget and intended use.
